洗脸、刷牙、整理床铺，禁止躺床上玩手机: Wash, brush your teeth, and make your bed. Keep your phone away.
吃早餐，出去走走，接触自然光: Have breakfast, go outside, and get some daylight.
写下今天必须完成的 3 个学习目标: Write down three essential learning goals.
学习新知识，例如 MCP、RAG、Agent 架构、Python 异步: Learn something new: MCP, RAG, agent architecture, or Python async.
离开座位，散步、喝水、看窗外: Leave your seat, walk, drink water, and look outside.
阅读技术文档，运行示例代码，理解实现原理: Read documentation, run examples, and understand how they work.
出去散步，闭眼休息，禁止刷手机: Take a walk and rest your eyes. Keep your phone away.
自己编写代码，验证上午学习的技术: Write code to try out this morning's learning.
活动身体，回到学习状态: Move your body and return to a learning mindset.
FinPilot / Coding Agent，实现一个具体功能: FinPilot / Coding Agent: implement one concrete feature.
起身活动、喝水: Stand up, move, and drink water.
继续开发，完成核心逻辑: Continue development and finish the core logic.
收盘后看持仓、交易计划，最多 10 分钟: Review holdings and your trading plan for up to 10 minutes.
调试代码，处理异常，解决技术问题: Debug, handle exceptions, and solve technical problems.
散步、拉伸、闭眼: Walk, stretch, and rest your eyes.
编写测试、检查代码、Git 提交: Write tests, review code, and commit changes.
跑步、引体向上、散步，按身体状态调整: Run, do pull-ups, or walk according to how you feel.
Agent 八股、Python 八股、项目设计原理: Review agents, Python concepts, and project design.
复盘当天代码、整理笔记、解释技术实现: Review today's code, take notes, and explain what you learned.
散步、聊天、听音乐，尽量不碰手机: Walk, chat, or listen to music. Limit phone use.
独立思考一道题，卡住就学题解，总结关键性质: Think through a problem independently; study a solution if stuck.
洗漱、整理明天需要的东西: Wash and prepare what you need for tomorrow.
不碰短视频、不打游戏，尽量在宿舍安静后入睡: Avoid short videos and games. Settle down for sleep.
天行健，君子以自强不息。: As the heavens keep moving, keep improving yourself.
自然运行刚健不息，君子也应不断进取。把自我提升落实到今天的一次行动中。: Nature moves steadily. Turn self-improvement into one action today.

路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。: The road is long; I will keep searching high and low.
追寻理想的道路漫长而艰难，仍要不断探索。眼前暂时没有答案，也可以继续求索。: The path to an ideal may be difficult. Keep exploring even without immediate answers.
一个知道自己为何而活的人，几乎可以忍受任何一种生活。: A clear purpose helps us endure difficult circumstances.
清楚自己为何而努力，往往能更有力量地面对困难。先找到行动的意义，再走好眼前这一步: Know why you are making an effort, then take the next step.

一点浩然气，千里快哉风。: An upright spirit can feel the freedom of a boundless wind.
胸中保有正直坦荡的气概，即使身处逆境，也能感受到开阔与自在。: An open, honest spirit can find room to breathe even in adversity.
苏轼《水调歌头·黄州快哉亭赠张偓佺》: Su Shi, Water Tune: Huangzhou Kuaizai Pavilion (editorial translation)
未经省察的人生不值得过。: An unexamined life is not worth living.
留出时间审视自己的选择与生活，才能更清楚地知道什么值得投入。: Make time to examine your choices and discover what deserves your attention.

即使结果尚未到来，清醒地投入奋斗，本身也能赋予生活充实感。: Committed effort can give life meaning even before a result arrives.
阿尔贝·加缪《西西弗神话》末章（中文节译）: After Albert Camus, The Myth of Sisyphus, final chapter (paraphrase)
对你心中一切尚未解决的问题保持耐心。: Be patient with the questions still unresolved within you.
不必催促所有困惑立刻得到答案。允许自己在经历和实践中，慢慢长出理解。: You do not need every answer immediately. Understanding can grow through experience.
里尔克《给青年诗人的信》第四封，1903 年 7 月 16 日（中文节译）: After Rainer Maria Rilke, Letters to a Young Poet, Letter 4 (paraphrase)
愤世嫉俗者知道一切事物的价格，却不知道任何事物的价值。: Knowing a price is not the same as knowing a value.
价格可以衡量成本，却无法穷尽事物的意义。也为热爱、关系和成长保留位置。: Cost cannot capture every kind of meaning. Make room for love, relationships, and growth.
奥斯卡·王尔德《温德米尔夫人的扇子》第三幕，道林顿勋爵的台词（中文译述）: After Oscar Wilde, Lady Windermere's Fan, Act III (paraphrase)
人生对我们任何人都不容易，但那又怎样？我们必须有毅力。: Life is difficult; perseverance still matters.
困难是生活的一部分。承认它的存在，同时保有毅力，继续做自己认定有价值的事。: Acknowledge difficulty and keep pursuing what you believe is worthwhile.
玛丽·居里；见艾芙·居里《居里夫人传》所引书信（中文节译）: After Marie Curie, correspondence cited in Eve Curie's biography (paraphrase)
此心安处是吾乡。: Where the heart rests, there is home.
能让内心安定的地方，就是精神上的归宿。身在变化之中，也可以培养自己的安稳与从容。: An inner sense of stability can grow even amid change.

男儿到死心如铁。看试手，补天裂。: Keep your resolve firm, and try to mend the broken sky.
